about.title: About us
about.text: For over a decade, ATEX has been a leader among sublimation printing houses, combining precision, innovation, and a passion for detail. We offer comprehensive sublimation printing on polyester fabrics and materials, ideal for custom apparel production - from T-shirts and hoodies to sportswear and corporate uniforms. Our professional graphic team will help you develop or optimize your design to ensure every print looks perfect. Thanks to modern equipment and continuous development, we guarantee colors that do not fade and remain durable during washing and use. Hundreds of clients have already trusted us - from fashion brands to event organizers. Have an idea? Write to us - we will realize it with the utmost care!

sublimation.title: Sublimation
sublimation.description: Sublimation printing is a durable and vibrant method of marking polyester fabrics. Ideal for sportswear and fashion, ensuring the highest quality and aesthetics.
sublimation.text: Sublimation printing is a modern technology that allows for the application of full-color patterns directly onto polyester fabrics. Colors are vivid, durable, and wash-resistant. Sublimation technology is ideal for producing sports kits, branded collections, event T-shirts, or personalized clothing. Sublimation allows for design freedom: from single elements to roll-to-roll printing. Choose sublimation if you care about aesthetics, quality, and print longevity.

dtfPrint.title: DTF Printing (Direct to Film)
dtfPrint.description: DTF is an innovative print for every type of fabric. It provides vivid colors, detail, and durability. Ideal for small series and personalization from just 1 piece.
dtfPrint.text: DTF printing is an innovative method of applying prints to any type of fabric - cotton, polyester, blends, or even dark materials. It guarantees intense colors, excellent detail reproduction, and durability comparable to screen printing. It works perfectly for small series, personalized t-shirts, promotional gadgets, or unique artistic projects. DTF is a flexible and economical solution where sublimation does not work - without compromising on quality, providing excellent results from 1 piece.

screenPrinting.title: Screen printing
screenPrinting.description: Screen printing is a classic method ideal for high volumes. It guarantees durability, low costs, and clear logos on corporate and event clothing.
screenPrinting.text: Screen printing is a proven, classic printing technology, ideal for high volumes and simple designs. By using appropriate inks, you get a clear, durable effect - especially with single or multi-color logos. Often used for corporate clothing, advertising campaigns, team outfits, or event t-shirts. Screen printing is the choice when you need a solid, economical, and fast solution for a larger audience.

logoTags.title: Labels, inserts
logoTags.description: Sublimation and woven tags are the key to your brand's recognition. Personalized, durable, and aesthetic - perfect for clothing and accessories.
logoTags.text: Professional neck and hang tags are a subtle but effective way to build brand recognition. We offer sublimation tags (soft, full color) and woven tags (classic, durable). Ideal for: fashion clothing, designer collections, gift bags, totes, or accessories. Possibility to customize the shape, color, and content - your logo, brand name, or slogan will always be in place.

eventAndMarketingClothing.title: Promotional and event clothing
eventAndMarketingClothing.description: Personalized clothing with your logo: from T-shirts to jackets. Any printing method, well-known brands, and graphic support. Fast turnaround and high quality.
eventAndMarketingClothing.text: Clothing with your branding - fast, reliable, and in line with your brand vision. We create T-shirts, hoodies, polo shirts, hats, fleeces, and jackets with sublimation, DTF, screen printing, or flex/flock prints - depending on your needs. Perfect for: conferences, festivals, marketing campaigns, open days, or uniforms for employees and teams. We offer both ready-made products and production from scratch - along with help from our graphic team. Our offer includes products from brands such as Fruit of the Loom, Malfini, JHK, Roly, Gildan, and AWDis.

graphicStudio.title: Graphic studio
graphicStudio.description: Creative designs for sublimation and DTF. We combine design with technical knowledge, providing print-ready files. Make your brand stand out on the market!
graphicStudio.text: We bring fabrics to life through unique design. Our team specializes in designing for sublimation and DTF printing. We combine creativity with technical knowledge, guaranteeing the highest quality, vivid colors, and precision. We support clothing brands and textile manufacturers by providing production-ready files. Whether you need pattern repeats or placements - we create designs that stand out on the market. Trust the professionals. Contact us and start collaborating today!
